summary.text: Ann Fredericks, a Republican, represents House District 143 (Sanford) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Sanford. The House profile lists membership on the Health and Human Services and Veterans and Legal Affairs committees.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives nurse practitioner as the occupation and lists BSN, MPA and MSN degrees dated 1985, 1992 and 1999.
Listed affiliations include the American Association of Nurse Practitioners and the Sanford YMCA.
